details: President Donald Trump has reiterated strong warnings against Iran acquiring nuclear weapons, suggesting such a development could ignite a nuclear conflict in the Middle East with global repercussions. He also voiced concerns regarding potential transit fees for the Strait of Hormuz, asserting the U.S. maintains complete control over this critical oil shipping lane. The ongoing tensions in the Middle East are contributing to global inflation and market uncertainty.
title: Trump Issues Warnings on Iran, Strait of Hormuz Transit Fees

details: The U.S. Department of Commerce is dedicating over $2 billion through the CHIPS and Science Act to bolster the quantum technology sector. This significant investment aims to accelerate the development of fault-tolerant quantum systems, with major tech firms like IBM and GlobalFoundries receiving substantial funding for hardware manufacturing and solving complex engineering challenges.
title: US Government Invests $2 Billion in Quantum Computing Infrastructure

details: Trump Media & Technology Group is reportedly preparing to sell off a considerable amount of its Bitcoin holdings, specifically 11,542 BTC, which were acquired at a premium price of $118,522 per coin. This potential liquidation comes as Bitcoin's price hovers around $77,000, following a substantial first-quarter net loss for the company and a significant drop in its stock value.
title: Trump Media May Liquidate Bitcoin Holdings Amidst Losses
